# Three.js

Three.js **0.187.0**, by the Three.js authors, is distributed under the [MIT license](LICENSE).

Upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js>

The files are from the version-pinned npm package. Its SHA-512 integrity and each shipped file's SHA-256 are recorded in [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json). The module and core were minified locally with esbuild 0.28.2. The module's core import and OrbitControls' bare `three` import were changed to local relative imports. No CDN is needed at runtime.

Official API references: [WebGLRenderer](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html), [OrbitControls](https://threejs.org/docs/pages/OrbitControls.html).
